opportunities.title: British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; UK citizens or EEA nationals (any nationality with a UK doctorate also eligible); must have completed doctorate between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; must not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award to early‑career researchers to pursue an independent research project leading to a significant publishable output, funded 80 % of salary costs under FEC.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026‑27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation; must be based in the humanities or social sciences; must be resident in the UK; independent researchers without institutional affiliation are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Up to £10,000 award (6‑12 months) to develop new skills, methods or collaborations in the humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards 2026‑27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation position; must have teaching/admin duties that can be relieved; lead applicant must be from one Academy remit and co‑applicant(s) from a different Academy remit (Social Sciences/Humanities, Engineering, or Natural Sciences).
opportunities.summary: Seed funding (up to 24 months, up to £200,000) for interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven projects across the three Academies (British Academy, Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering).

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher (early‑career to senior) in the humanities or social sciences; must have some prior public‑engagement experience; previous award recipients not eligible to re‑apply.
opportunities.summary: Funding (up to £8,000) for innovative public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts partners, running between Apr 2027 and Dec 2028.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at UK or German institutions.
opportunities.summary: Travel, accommodation and visa costs funded for up to 15 UK and 15 German early‑career scholars to attend a three‑day symposium (21‑23 Apr 2027) on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral level or above) with an eligible UK university or research institute; must involve overseas co‑applicants and interdisciplinary collaboration across SHAPE or STEM disciplines.
opportunities.summary: Funding (up to £300,000, 80 % FEC) for 24‑month interdisciplinary projects on the theme of Mobilities, beginning March/April 2027.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships – DGAP 2026‑27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑career or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must be able to be based in Berlin at the German Council on Foreign Relations.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150,000, 80 % FEC) to work at DGAP in Berlin on policy‑relevant research in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology & AI, or strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months; must meet eligibility of the target scheme.
opportunities.summary: Rolling‑deadline funding (up to £4,000) to support additional needs such as equipment for disabled researchers, caring costs, or assistance to prepare applications.
